legal_units.title: Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 185.
legal_units.text: If a person takes or accepts any loan or deposit or specified sum in contravention of the provisions of section 185, the Assessing Officer may impose on him, a penalty equal to the amount of the loan or deposit or specified sum so taken or accepted.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Chapter XXI PENALTIES Section 450 Penalty for failure to comply with provisions of section 185. If a person takes or accepts any loan or deposit or specified sum in contravention of the provisions of section 185, the Assessing Officer may impose on him, a penalty equal to the amount of the loan or deposit or specified sum so taken or accepted.
